messages:
maria: Quick async check — can we list current owners and blockers for the new GPU racks arriving next month? Need firmware/BIOS slot, network cabling window, and who owns the reservation mapping to customer commitments.

aj: I can own firmware/BIOS validation and baseline image. ETA for validation run: 2 business days after racks are racked. Blocker: need IPMI creds from infra onboarding ticket.

ben: Shipping ETA from vendor is still 10–12 business days (PO-4832). Customs could add a week. I flagged expedited shipping but cost is nontrivial.

sylvie: For network cabling, we need a site window — ops team only has a 4-hour slot booked on 2026-04-12. If racks arrive late, we need fallback. Owner: sylvie (network). Blocker: site contact confirmation.

maria: @aj please create a small test plan (firmware + smoke test + kv-cache sanity) and post it here. Include exact commands we should run in the canary.

aj: Will do. Draft test plan excerpt:```bash
# on new node
sudo fwupdmgr get-devices
sudo fwupdmgr update --show-progress
# smoke: run minimal model load
./inference-smoke --model small --tokens 128 --batch 4
```

kevin: Quick note from product: we have two Dedicated customers that expect cutover by 2026-05-01. Can we guarantee reservation mapping by 2026-04-25? If not, we need to push deadlines.

ben: With current shipping + customs risk, 2026-04-25 is tight. If vendor hits the early ship date, maybe. Otherwise we should set expectation to 2026-05-08.

sylvie: Ops can add a second cabling crew (extra cost) to hit 04-25 if hardware is onsite by 04-18. Need approval from infra finance.

maria: Action items I have so far: 1) @aj - firmware/test plan (owner) 2) @ben - confirm final ETD + tracking (owner) 3) @sylvie - site window + backup crew option (owner) 4) @kevin - relay risk to customers and ask for 1-week flex if needed. Please reply with OK + any additional blockers.

aj: OK — test plan coming in ~3 hours. I'll request IPMI creds in ticket INFRA-912.

ben: OK — POC to vendor scheduled for tomorrow. Ill update tracking by EOD with either confirmed ETD or customs hold risk.

sylvie: OK — I'll ping site and request backup crew quote. If we need the extra crew, call it out here and I'll start approval.

kevin: OK — I'll tentatively tell customers we may be +1 week, will ask for flexibility. If we get firm 04-18 arrival I can keep 04-25.

deploy-bot: NOTE: automated reservation system currently shows 0 unassigned slots for week of 2026-05-01. If hardware arrives late, we will need to reallocate or extend capacity reservations.

maria: Thanks all. I'll summarize in the project doc and tag owners on the milestone board. If anyone discovers additional blockers (customs docs, rack power lines, QUIC certs), drop them here. :thumbsup:
